result.stdout:
Cognita - semantic code knowledge graph CLI

usage:
  cognita --help
  cognita version
  cognita extract <repo_path> --out <facts_dir> [--syntax-only]
  cognita stats <facts_dir>
  cognita verify <facts_dir>
  cognita query <facts_dir> "<query>" [--format text|json|jsonl]
    DSL: nodes|edges|symbol "<name>"|project "<name>" | where ... | incoming|outgoing|both ... | select ... | order by ... | limit ...
    Natural language examples: "what does OrderService call", "who implements IOrderService", "show classes related to order"
  cognita find symbol <facts_dir> <name> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita callers <facts_dir> <symbol> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita callees <facts_dir> <symbol> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita implements <facts_dir> <type> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita inherits <facts_dir> <type> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita impact <facts_dir> <symbol> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita deps <facts_dir> --project <project> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita entrypoints <facts_dir> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita locate <facts_dir> <symbol> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita explain type <facts_dir> <type> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita explain method <facts_dir> <method> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita summarize repo <facts_dir> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita summarize project <facts_dir> <project> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita map architecture <facts_dir> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita map feature <facts_dir> <symbol-or-query> [--format text|json|jsonl]
  cognita diff <old_facts_dir> <new_facts_dir> [--format text|json|jsonl|markdown] [--exit-code]
  cognita check <facts_dir> [--rules <file>] [--format text|json|jsonl|markdown]
  cognita snapshot create|info|verify <facts_dir>
  cognita snapshot export <facts_dir> <archive.zip>
  cognita snapshot import <archive.zip> <target_dir>
  cognita mcp <facts_dir>            (stdio MCP server exposing the fact graph to AI agents)
